cells.quote: By offering adaptive recommendations, recommender systems effectively balance guidance with learner autonomy, making them a valuable tool for supporting SRL (Du & Hew, 2022).
cells.note: The review presents this as a narrative synthesis claim; no common comparison condition or pooled effect size is reported.

D.treatment: recommender systems used to support learner agency and SRL

O.outcome_detail: perceived satisfaction, quality, usefulness, and acceptance

cells.quote: Du and Hew (2022) reviewed 20 empirical articles and reported that students generally responded positively to the use of recommender systems.
cells.note: The reported positive response is a synthesis statement without a specified comparator, outcome statistic, or pooled effect size.
